# Staples Canada

> > Staples Canada's online storefront offering same-day delivery and curbside pickup for office supplies, electronics, and specialty products including Dubai Chocolate confections.

Staples Canada operates a comprehensive e-commerce platform providing convenient same-day delivery and pickup options for business and consumer needs. The site features traditional office products alongside trending specialty items like Dubai Chocolate varieties and popular candy brands.

## Key Topics

- Same-day delivery
- Curbside pickup
- Office supplies
- Dubai Chocolate (Choco Bubu varieties)
- Candy and confections
- M&M's
- Storefront services
- Local store availability
- Quick fulfillment options
- Business products
- Consumer electronics

## Delivery & Pickup Services

- [Staples Delivery or Pickup Near Me](https://sameday.staples.ca/store/staples-can/storefront): Main storefront for same-day delivery and curbside pickup services across Staples Canada locations
